name: Lyrion Laurel-Envoy
firstAppearance: Campaign 02: Trial of the Celestial Heights
lore: Lyrion designs divine contests to measure whether deities deserve passage through contested Gates. He frames battles as tests of excellence rather than simple survival.
personality: Elegant, proud, theatrical, dangerous when dishonored.
physicalDescription: Marble-skinned envoy with bronze laurel crown, star-thread mantle, sculptural golden mask, and hovering victory tablets.
gameplayFunction: Challenge mission narrator, objective modifier source, Olympian codex voice.
